newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends flat, mkt awaits mini-band drop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends flat, mkt awaits mini-band drop.

text.p: Brazil's real closed steady at 1.0764 per dollar in calm trading in the commercial foreign exchange market with players forecasting a 0.1 percent decline in the reais-dollar mini-band on Monday, dealers said.
Monday is the last day of the month and the Central Bank has changed the mini-band on this day for the last several months, traders said.
The Central Bank last lowered the mini-band on June 25 to between 1.0755 and 1.0805 reais per dollar.
So far this month, the mini-band has fallen 0.51 percent compared to monthly declines of between 0.57 and 0.63 percent in the past six months.
Dealers also expect an increase in liquidity on Monday since some players who have been holding dollars might sell them in arbitraging operations with the forex futures market.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0813 per greenback, down 0.03 percent.
In the parallel market, the real closed steady at 1.135 per dollar, traders said.
